notice: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Invented people, property and documents.

terms.title: Roof leak repair under work order 14 (synthetic sample)
terms.claim: The roof leak repairs in work order 14 were completed before the maintenance deadline of 17:00 on 26 September 2026.

criteria.text: Evidence shows the contractor attended the property to carry out work order 14.
Evidence shows each task in work order 14 was performed: the slipped slates replaced, the chimney flashing resealed on every face, and the front gutter cleared.
Evidence shows all of the work in work order 14 was completed, with nothing left unfinished.
Evidence shows the leak into the bathroom ceiling, which the repair addressed, has stopped or improved.
Evidence shows the work was completed before 17:00 on 26 September 2026, Europe/London time.

limitations: The assessment does not test the roof under rain.
Dates printed on photographs are the camera's setting and are not independently verified.

evidence.description: The roof before the repair: slipped slates above the bathroom and a tarp.
The roof after the repair: four new slates and new flashing at the chimney.
Invoice 2291 for the work, paid in full.

documents.work-order.txt:
Work order 14 (SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA)
Issued 14 September 2026 by Riverside Lettings (synthetic) to Northgate Roofing (synthetic).
Property: Riverside flat (synthetic).

Tasks:
1. Replace the slipped slates above the bathroom.
2. Reseal the chimney flashing on every face.
3. Clear the front gutter.

Complete by 17:00 on 26 September 2026.
documents.contractor-statement.txt:
Contractor statement, Northgate Roofing (SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA)

I attended Riverside flat on 25 September 2026 from 09:00 to 16:00. I replaced four slipped slates on the south face, resealed the chimney flashing and cleared the front gutter. Work order 14 is complete.
documents.contractor-second-visit.txt:
Second visit, Northgate Roofing (SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA)

After the inspection report I returned to Riverside flat on 28 September 2026 from 08:30 to 10:00 and resealed the chimney flashing on the north face. The photograph filed with this note shows it.
documents.inspection-report.txt:
Inspection report, Riverside Lettings (SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA)
Inspected 27 September 2026 at 10:30.

Bathroom ceiling: the stain is still present. Moisture meter reads 27% at the centre of the stain against 12% on dry plaster nearby.
Loft: the timber below the chimney is damp to the touch.
Roof, seen from the loft hatch and from the garden: four newer slates on the south face. The north face flashing has not been replaced and the old flashing is lifted in two places.

Work order 14 asked for the flashing to be resealed on every face. It is not complete.
